state.storage: The entry stream supports a durable conditional append at the exact observed resource position. Competing appends at the same position cannot both commit. The caller verifies the exact committed edition-start event and has a qualified fresh entry head before deciding. No provider is presently qualified.
state.race: A publication start targets an absent entry. An independently authorized create proposal competes with a witness refusal at the same empty resource position.
state.retry: A previously committed refusal is hydrated for the selected attempt, and the same start event is delivered again.

pending.instructions: Can RefuseWitness emit a refusal when an entry mutation is unresolved?

exact_live.instructions: Can RefuseWitness emit a refusal when the exact requested criterion incarnation is accepted and available to pin?

retry.instructions: In state.retry does the exact refusal retry return success without a new fact?

delayed_pin.instructions: After a refusal commits and is replayed, does the same attempt remain able to append a witness pin?

race.instructions: In state.race can both competing writes commit at the same source position under the stated storage assumption?

provider.instructions: Does state.storage say a production freshness provider has been qualified?
